geographic_coverage: Global (11 flood events; held-out India test: 68 chips acquired on 2016-08-12)
known_limitations: Permanent water bodies and flood-inundated surfaces share the same label (1); flood extent requires baseline permanent water removal.
Urban double-bounce causes flooded built-up areas to exhibit high radar backscatter rather than characteristic specular low backscatter.
Vegetation canopies can attenuate or mask underlying flood water in C-band SAR.
